ordering_conflicts.description: Declared layer graph is not buildable as written
ordering_conflicts.issue: Layer 4 (foundation) contains data models (Link, Tag, LinkTag) that layer 3 (backend) endpoints depend on. The declared depends_on chain places foundation AFTER backend, making it impossible to implement backend tasks before foundation exists.
ordering_conflicts.required_order: foundation tasks must be completed before backend tasks can depend on the models

layers_dropped.reason: No integration work exists. Integration layer requires cross-layer wiring (e.g., API to frontend, setup to data layer). With only backend and no frontend, and with setup and foundation as prerequisites, wiring is deferred until frontend is added.
No frontend components. PRD states 'Backend only - no frontend, no container runtime.' frontend_components list is empty.

tasks.name: Initialize project structure
tasks.description: Create package directories, pyproject.toml, requirements, and pytest config for a Python FastAPI + SQLAlchemy project
provides: Package structure with FastAPI app skeleton

tasks.name: Initialize git and virtual environment
tasks.description: Create .gitignore, initialize git repo (if not done), create and activate venv, install dependencies

tasks.name: Verify development environment
tasks.description: Run a basic FastAPI startup check and confirm pytest can discover tests

tasks.name: Create Link model
tasks.description: SQLAlchemy ORM model for storing URLs with optional titles and timestamps
provides: Link ORM model (id, url, title, created_at)

tasks.name: Create Tag and LinkTag models
tasks.description: SQLAlchemy models for tags and the many-to-many junction table linking tags to links

tasks.name: Create database migrations
tasks.description: Alembic migrations to create links, tags, and linktags tables with foreign keys and indexes
provides: links table with url not null, title nullable, created_at timestamp
linktags junction table with composite primary key

tasks.name: Implement POST /links endpoint
tasks.description: Accept URL and optional title; validate URL format; store and return 201 with id, url, title, created_at
provides: Response 422 for missing or invalid URL

tasks.name: Implement GET /links endpoint
tasks.description: Return all stored links ordered newest first; support optional tag query parameter to filter by tag
provides: Response 200 with empty array when no links

tasks.name: Implement POST /links/{id}/tags endpoint
tasks.description: Attach tags to an existing link; handle duplicate tags idempotently; return link with all tags
provides: Idempotent tag attachment (duplicate tags attached only once)
Response 200 with updated link object including tags
Response 404 if link id does not exist

summary.note: Layers 1-integration and 2-frontend dropped (no work). Declared graph has a critical ordering conflict: foundation depends on backend in the declared graph, but data models (foundation) must be built before backend endpoints can be implemented. Implementation must follow the buildable order (setup → foundation → backend), not the declared order.
